english: It was mainly for this reason that the Brazilian government decided to have a new city built 600 miles north-west of Rio de Janeiro.
text: It was mainly for this reason that 把主要原因单独凸显出来，接住上文的开发不足。have a new city built 是安排别人把城市建成，不是政府亲手施工；表达委托或组织完成工程时，have something done 比只说 build 更能交代这种关系。
